functions.function_requirement:
Function Name: book_recommender

Description:
  Book catalog filter with environment-based version control.
  Loads books.csv, filters on genre column equality, formats output per API_VERSION:
    • v1: returns array of title column values
    • v2: returns object with titles, total count, and rating mean
    • v3: returns schema.org compliant BookCollection object

Parameters:
  – genre (string): genre value for CSV filtering
  – file_path (string): path to books.csv data file

Return Specifications:
  v1 → List[str] containing titles, example: ["Novel A", "Novel B", ...]

  v2 → Dictionary format:
      {
        "titles": ["Novel A", "Novel B", ...],
        "count": 20,
        "avg_rating": 4.15
      }

  v3 → Dictionary format:
      {
        "@context": "http://schema.org",
        "@type": "BookCollection",
        "numberOfItems": 20
      }

Example Calls:

# v1 default behavior
titles = book_recommender("Horror", "dataset/books.csv")
# result: ["Horror Story 1", "Horror Story 2", ...]

# v2 with environment variable
result = book_recommender("Horror", "dataset/books.csv")
# result: {"titles": ["Horror Story 1", ...], "count": 15, "avg_rating": 3.8}

# v3 with environment variable
result = book_recommender("Horror", "dataset/books.csv")
# result: {"@context": "http://schema.org", "@type": "BookCollection", "numberOfItems": 15}
functions.user_input: Create a book_recommender function that filters books by genre from books.csv in PROJECT KNOWLEDGE. Parameters: genre (string) and file_path (path of file (string)). Use os.environ.get('API_VERSION', 'v1') to detect version. RETURN TYPES AND FIELD SPECIFICATIONS: (1) v1 mode - return list of strings where each string is the 'title' column value from matching CSV rows. (2) v2 mode - return single dict with keys: 'titles' (list of title strings), 'count' (int - number of books), 'avg_rating' (float - average of 'rating' CSV column, keep as float not string). (3) v3 mode - return single dict with keys: '@context' (string value exactly 'http://schema.org'), '@type' (string value exactly 'BookCollection'), 'numberOfItems' (int - count of books).
